title: J&K Waqf Board sets national benchmark in financial management: Kiren Rijiju

ai.summary: Union Minister Kiren Rijiju praised Jammu and Kashmir Waqf Board's financial management and developmental initiatives, calling it a model for other Waqf Boards across India.

facts.claim: Union Minister for Minority Affairs Kiren Rijiju praised the financial management and developmental initiatives of the Jammu and Kashmir Waqf Board
facts.quote: Tangmarg, Nov 24: Union Minister for Minority Affairs Kiren Rijiju on Tuesday praised the financial management and developmental initiatives of the Jammu and Kashmir Waqf Board, saying its work could serve as a model for Waqf Boards across the country.

facts.claim: Rijiju inaugurated the newly constructed guest house at Baba Reshi shrine in Baramulla district
facts.quote: Rijiju was speaking during his visit to the revered Baba Reshi shrine in Baramulla district, where he inaugurated the newly constructed guest house, paid obeisance and interacted with religious delegations.

facts.claim: Rijiju described the Jammu and Kashmir Waqf Board as having done the best work among Waqf Boards in the country
facts.quote: The Jammu and Kashmir Waqf Board has done the best work among Waqf Boards in the country. Other Boards should take inspiration from its work,

ai.background_note: The Jammu and Kashmir Waqf Board has been recognized for its financial management and developmental initiatives, with Rijiju highlighting its role in preserving religious heritage and improving facilities for devotees.
